lines.zh: 我踩着碎步，鞋底不沾尘。
lines.en: I step lightly, my soles gathering no dust.
I hop, land, and move on.

lines.zh: 我用脚尖试着地面的弹性。
lines.en: I test the ground with my toes.
Ki coils around my ankle.
I walk light, as if weightless.
I lift a hand to fix my hair.

lines.zh: 地上的影子跳得比我快。
lines.en: My shadow hops faster than I do.
I circle closer to you.
My steps keep a rhythm.
I step over a wildflower, unbroken.
I stop, then walk on.
Every step keeps half an inch of margin.
I rest my hands on my hips and wait.
I shake the dirt off my feet.
Is anyone watching my form?
I straighten my hem in a puddle's reflection.
The show hasn't started yet.
I balance on one foot, steady.
My breathing is light.
I count the heartbeats across from me.
When bored, I kick pebbles.

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的开场。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a proper opening.
My legs are more reliable than my hands.
One gust and my hair is ruined.

lines.zh: 我抬手看看自己的指甲。
lines.en: I raise a hand to check my nails.
This ground is uneven.
So you're the lead?

lines.zh: 站好，让我看看你的架势。
lines.en: Stand properly, show me your stance.
All your weight is on the right foot.
I rarely praise, you're not bad.
You're so tense you forgot to breathe.
Just remember my name.
That thing in your hand is too heavy.
Don't look away, I'm speaking.
Compared to me, you're far behind.
I smile because you're amusing.
You need new boots.
Chin up, keep a good posture.
You'd best watch when I strike.
I've chosen this spot.
You're too serious, loosen up.
I admire that stubborn streak.
Though admiration is admiration.
Watch closely, this is how to stand.
My hair, you've messed it up.
That was inelegant.
A tear in my clothes.

lines.zh: 我一受伤就闪开，再连踢。
lines.en: Hit me and I dodge, then kick.
It hurts, but I can still dance.
Not the face, anything else.
I step back half a pace and reset.

lines.zh: 被打断了步点，我重整鞋尖。
lines.en: My rhythm's broken; I reset on my toes.
You actually kept up.
Now I'm serious, truly.
Would that buy my life?
Leave it, maybe if I'm in a good mood.
Doesn't smell bad.
You're stalling, aren't you?

lines.zh: 我这身肌肉，生来是打人的。
lines.en: These muscles were made for fighting.
Move it, it blocks my light.
I am a little hungry, actually.
Both your hands are trembling.
Is this a bribe? I accept.
One bite, and no chatter.
You stepped on my shoe.
Don't press so close, it's rude.
One turn and I slip aside.
You hit nothing, didn't you?
My clothes nearly creased.
Back off, I still have to dance.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞得我偏了半步。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked me half a step off.
Not even that much footwork.
Make way, don't block me.
I can't be bothered with you.

lines.zh: 我的舞伴要跟得上拍子。
lines.en: My partner must keep the beat.
You can't even manage a turn.
I prefer being admired.
Such things depend on my mood.
Beat me once first.
You're too eager, it's unbecoming.
I only dance with the strong.
Don't mess up my collar.
You stepped on my foot, out.

lines.zh: 我的优雅是留给自己的。
lines.en: My grace is for myself.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的姿势也很漂亮。
lines.en: Even my bending looks good.
Whose litter is this?
I flick it up with my toe.
Dropped means mine.
This could fetch some coin.
I hold its edge, sparing my hands.
One glint and I saw it.
Don't think I missed it.
I drop it into my pouch.
Spoils should be arranged neatly.
You'll be my dance partner.
I've picked my footing.
One kick first, to test you.
You're standing in the wrong place.
I count to three and begin.
Don't blink, this part is quick.
I'll perform on this ground.
Your opening is far too obvious.
Let me teach you rhythm.
No running now.
A spin on my toes and I switch stance.
Where's the spotlight? Doesn't matter.
Raise your hands, guard your face.
This kick is the opening bow.

lines.zh: 我的节奏一响，你就完了。
lines.en: Once my tempo starts, you're finished.
Don't retreat, it ruins the look.
I can shift my weight anytime.
Watch my feet and you've lost.
I'm measuring the gaps in your breath.
One spin puts me at your flank.
This kick combo has five beats.
Your eyes can't keep up, can they?
I can change direction midair.
Hard ground works against you.
I'm not even warmed up.
Your stance is collapsing.
Don't block, your arm will break.
I smile once before I strike.

lines.zh: 你的牙在打颤，我听得见。
lines.en: Your teeth are chattering, I can hear it.
I'm at two.
Your exit is behind that wall.
This kick comes from above.
I'm saving the final blow.
You're already panting.
First kick, sweeps your knee.
Second kick, a bit higher.
A spinning kick, landed cleanly.
This one knocks your blade away.
I land with my foot on yours.
Can you follow the combo's tempo?
My instep cracks your ribs.
You only saw an afterimage.
The one in the air is the real one.
Don't clutch your gut, it's ugly.

lines.zh: 这一下踢乱了你的步伐。
lines.en: This scrambles your footwork.
After kicking I'll straighten my cuffs.
Your armor won't stop my toe.
Stand up, the next kick is heavier.
The rhythm pauses here.
This kick is the finale.

lines.zh: 我落地时只扬了一点尘。
lines.en: I land raising only a little dust.
I strike a pose before speaking.
This stage is mine to perform on.
I spiral down from the sky.
Toes touch ground, I've arrived.
You should be applauding.
I adjust my collar.
Where's the light? I bring my own.
Ki swirls around me.
This sky is room enough for a flip.
Don't fear, I only came to dance.
Before the show, remember my face.
I raise one leg in salute.
Is there an audience? Good.
A good show needs spectators.
You'll be saying my name soon enough.
Act one begins now.
I'm quite ready.
Fire caught my hem, how unsightly.

lines.zh: 落地的姿势这次没摆好。
lines.en: I didn't stick the landing this time.
Water up my nose, how undignified.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的造型吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blew my pose apart.
An arrow pins my sleeve.
Magic halts my step.
I can't dance on an empty stomach.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的头发全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning struck, my hair stands straight up.
No floor to step on in the void.
